newBlockTasks.name: forge-usecase
newBlockTasks.sectionHtml:
Enhance a photo, then totally transform it.

Prepare the perfect shoot with Firefly Boards.

Build a visual shot list and use AI to brainstorm ideas for locations, set designs, and compositions before you pick up a camera.

Import, organize, and make quick edits with Lightroom.

Batch-edit photos with color corrections, presets, and AI-powered tools. Then make selects and send them to Photoshop with a click.

Remix and reimagine with Photoshop.

Retouch your selects with unmatched precision and control, and then use them in image composites, digital paintings, and 3D artwork.

newBlockTasks.name: forge-usecase-3
newBlockTasks.sectionHtml:
Go from raw clips to release-ready videos.

Storyboard in Firefly Boards to speed up pre-production.

Generate a storyboard from your script to lock in your shot composition, camera angles, lighting style, color palette, and more.

Pr

Build your story frame by frame in Premiere.

Get to the right cut fast with industry-standard video editing tools and timesaving AI features.

Add motion graphics with After Effects.

Enhance your video with animated text and illustrations, realistic 3D animations, and attention-grabbing effects.

Bring your workflow together with Frame.io in Premiere.

Easily access, organize, and import media. Share sequences for review. And get the feedback you need, right on your timeline.

newBlockTasks.name: forge-usecase-4
newBlockTasks.sectionHtml:
Take your designs further, faster.

Jump-start design exploration with Firefly Boards.

Generate images and use moodboards to play with typography, color palettes, and logo directions as you develop your look and feel.

Craft logos and other design elements with Illustrator.

Design crisp, infinitely scalable vector graphics and illustrations with precision drawing and typography tools plus creative AI.

Make comps in Photoshop that combine vectors and images.

Retouch images and create mockups to visualize how all your elements come together in web pages, clothing designs, and more.

Integrate your designs into layouts with InDesign.

Create beautiful multi-page layouts for print and digital pitch decks, brand books, and business collateral.

Adapt your assets and stay on brand with Adobe Express.

Reformat design assets or turn them into social posts, flyers, and more. And create and share brand kits to keep things consistent.
